changes.title: Folder thumbnails and edited photos
items: Folder covers now use Immich thumbnails for both photos and videos.
Random folder covers now choose assets only from that folder.
Rotations and other edits made in Immich now appear in the app.

changes.title: More ways to browse
items: Filter the Timeline and media collections to show videos only.
Slideshows now loop continuously.

changes.title: Performance and reliability
items: Improved Timeline navigation and thumbnail loading for large libraries.
Slideshows now recover when the server is slow.
Added optional diagnostics with more accurate memory reporting.

changes.title: Timeline performance
items: Fixed severe vertical navigation delays in Timeline libraries containing exceptionally large months.
Timeline photos now load in bounded pages as you scroll instead of exposing an entire month to the focus engine at once.
Expanded the optional diagnostics overlay with Timeline, network, CPU, memory, and UI-stall measurements.

changes.title: Slideshows now loop
items: When a slideshow reaches the end, it starts over from the beginning instead of stopping on the last photo.

changes.title: Performance and reliability
items: Fixed sluggish remote navigation on the Timeline while photos were still loading.
Faster thumbnail loading, especially on first browse.
Fixed slideshows freezing on one photo when the server was slow to respond — they now recover automatically.
Added a diagnostics overlay in Settings to help troubleshoot performance issues.

changes.title: Timeline is now the default view
items: Timeline is now the default view for browsing All Photos.

changes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
items: Fixed a bug where the grid and keyboard showed overlapping content.
Fixed a bug where Timeline did not show photos shared by partners.

changes.title: More flexible library controls
items: Overhauled asset sorting controls.
Unified tab visibility settings.

changes.title: Refined browsing and sharing UI
items: Refined the Top Shelf, Explore, and shared album interfaces.

changes.title: Photo stacks and calendar browsing
items: Added stacked photo support.
Added calendar month browsing.

changes.title: Fixed a video playback issue where longer videos crashed.
items: Some longer videos have crashed for a while, but I think I have finally fixed it. If not there is always github issues.
few more minor backend improvemnts that should lead to better overall performance

changes.title: Folders view has seen a major UI overhaul.
items: Nested folders make it easier to navigate. You can view folder by folder or all images of a subfolder at once.
You can also folders view a-z, z-a, in the same page

changes.title: More filters and sort options
items: Lot more filters and sorting is supported in the timeline view.

changes.title: Locked Folder is now supported.
items: Unlock to view, back out of it and it locks automatically.
Always shows 0 images, this is not a bug but a privacy feature

changes.title: UI has been redesigned to use more native media lockups
items: Additionally, I have removed animated thumbnails since they always were bad for performance
Dont worry though, there is a new option to pick randomized thumbnails instead of default, if you like

changes.title: Images in album were limited to 250
items: This is a result of Immich V3 upgrade. Anyway, should be fixed now

changes.title: Immich V3 compatibility
items: Does what it says on the tin. Some additional imrpovements are coming.

changes.title: Fullscreen and Top Shelf polish
items: Fixed a broken top shelf thing
Fullscreen view now makes an extra api call but should load images much faster, focusing on a few more optimizations for this month considering I can no longer afford to switch to the new Apple Tvs

changes.title: ✨ Timeline is here ✨
items: Added a new Settings → Interface → Photos View option for Timeline - Beta. Timeline groups All Photos by month and loads sections on demand, making large libraries significantly faster to browse.
Timeline is still under testing, so keep using Grid if you want the most proven All Photos experience. Please share feedback or issues on GitHub.

changes.title: Pan & Zoom+ slideshow effect
items: Added a new Settings → Slideshow → Image Effects option called "Pan & Zoom+", which keeps the Ken Burns motion, mixes in dynamic transitions like zoom, fade, spin, and flip animations between photos, and balances transition families so the slideshow cycles through different visual styles more evenly.
Added a new Settings → Interface option to reverse left and right navigation in the fullscreen image viewer.

changes.title: Launch straight into a slideshow
items: New Settings → Interface → "Launch Into Slideshow" option starts the slideshow automatically when the app opens, using your slideshow config album if set (otherwise all photos). Off by default.
The slideshow trigger settings now live alongside Default Startup Tab in Interface, grouping the app's startup behavior together.

changes.title: Auto-slideshow stopped using your config
items: After the 1.2.2 fix, auto-slideshow could play whatever album/person you were viewing instead of your configured slideshow. It now reliably plays your slideshow config (or all photos when none is set).

changes.title: Slideshow played the wrong album
items: Pressing play on a specific album now plays that album, instead of always falling back to the auto-slideshow album.

changes.title: Granular Slideshow Overlay Controls
items: New Settings → Slideshow toggles to independently show or hide the current time widget, the photo's taken date, and the location.
Photo Date now has three modes: Date and Time, Date Only, or None.
Existing behavior preserved by default — turn things off only if you want to.

changes.title: Background & Library Controls
items: Added an app-wide background style picker in Settings → Interface, including a true black Midnight theme.
Added a new Settings → Sorting option to hide Filter and Sort buttons in the main library view.
When Filter and Sort buttons are hidden, the All Photos grid now reclaims that space to show more images.

changes.title: Folders UI hangs on large libraries
items: Fixed a bug where folders view may hang on large libraries.
Made some additional performance improvements to people and tags tab.

changes.title: All Photos Sort & Filter
items: Added sort and filter controls to the main library (All Photos) view.

changes.title: Tabs vs Sidebar
items: Pick your style in Settings → Interface. Tabs for the classics, Sidebar for the minimal.

changes.title: Sort Order & album cover
items: Fixed the sort order again.
If thumbnail animation is disabled, we now show album cover of the album.

changes.title: ✨✨New Icon✨✨
items: The Icon has been a placeholder for too long.

changes.title: Fix shared album content. Discussion#81
items: Thank you for reporting @madasus. Issue has been fixed.

changes.title: The overlay windows were broken on TvOS 26. Add user/whats new etc.Part of issue #75
items: Thanks for reporting @rmayergfx. This should fix that issue.

changes.title: Folders Tab
items: New opt-in Folders tab allows you to view folders from your external library.

changes.title: Sorting order
items: We are once again respecting the sorting order selected in settings.

changes.title: Performance Optimizations
items: Hopefully better video player.

changes.title: Performance Optimizations
items: Various performance improvements throughout the app for smoother navigation.
Enhanced loading times and reduced memory usage.
More improvements coming next for people with large libraries, for now, but if you're experiencing crashes when scrolling, please report.

changes.title: Explore Tab
items: New explore tab to discover your photos through statistics or by cities visited.

changes.title: Top Shelf Enhancement
items: Top shelf now shows only landscape orientation images for better visual presentation on Apple TV.

changes.title: Apple TV Top Shelf Customization
items: Be brave, embrace choas: Now you can choose to display random photos on top shelf.

changes.title: Raw Image Support
items: Raw images now work kinda maybe. TV cannot display RAW images natively so I now load a fullsize version provided by immich.

changes.title: Album & UI Enhancements
items: Albums now show all favorite photos as a new album. Do not worry, the album does not exist in reality, like me.
Performance improvements to the all photos tab.
Changes to settings page as usual.

changes.title: Auto Slideshow Configuration (experimental only)
items: This may go away if I can't convince myself this is good.
Create empty album named "immich-gallery-config" with specific description format. Check settings for more info on setup.
Support for both album and person-based slideshow configuration

changes.title: Dimmed Slideshow
items: Add support for dimmed slideshow in settings.
Time based dim level
How good does it work is a matter of personal opinion/s. Try it out and let me know. Yes, I'm talking to you specifically.

changes.title: Sign In With API key
items: All of the SSO users can now use API keys to sign in. Not sure what will break if the API does not have needed scopes. Eventually maybe I'll list them out but for now, take a guess based on the available features.

changes.title: Cleanups
items: Bug fixes and performance improvements.
Album view now shows "shared by you" for the albums shared by you.
Cleaner settings view.

changes.title: Slideshow optimizations
items: Rewrite SlideshowView for loading assets dynamically

changes.title: Albums tab
items: Fix shared albums are duplicated
Fix slideshow does not work for shared-in albums

changes.title: Fix more bugs
items: Make slideshow truly random, just like life. Outsourced this to the server. - #43
Fix inactivity timer - Browse fast or the automatic slideshow will catch up to you - #43
Remove date of birth from people tab - WAF+10 - #44

changes.title: Fix bugs
items: Top shef portraits no longer do unexpected headstands or cartwheels. I Hope.
Hopefully it also won't crash. But you may see reduced image quality in top shelf.
Better error handling.
Changed color gradient, this is much better on the eyes, I think.
